ELECTROMAGNETIC RADIATION HAZARDS                 EXIST AT THE WAVEGUIDE OUTPUT FROM
THE POWER AMPLIFIER AND WITHIN THE                 DIRECTIONAL PATTERN OF THE ANTEN-
NA! DO NOT STAND IN THE DIRECT PATH               OF THE ANTENNA NOR WORK ON WAVE-

GUIDES WHILE POWER IS ON!

High frequency electromagnetic      radiation can cause fatal burns. It can literally  “cook”  internal
organs and flesh. If you feel the  slightest warming effect while near this equipment  MOVE    AWAY
QUICKLY!

             Section Il. INITIAL ADJUSTMENTS OF EQUIPMENT

                                                   CAUTION
All interconnection cables must be connected before application of primary ac power
to the radio set. DO NOT connect or disconnect power, control cables, or modules
while primary ac power is applied to the radio set.

                                                      NOTE
Except for paragraph 2-149, the initial adjustments contained in paragraph 2-14
must be performed by organizational, or higher, maintenance personnel. The
adjustmens must be performed when the equipment shelter containing the
AN/GRC-143 is initially delivered to the field or is subsequently relocated.

2-14. Extent of Initial Adjustments                             h. Initial receiver traffic level adjustment (para
                                                             2-18).
Before the radio set can be used for routine operation
as described in chapter 3, the procedures listed in a          i. Radio set loop back test (para 5-28).
through k below must be performed.                             j. Power amplifier tuning procedure (para 3-13).
                                                                k. Establishing initial communications (para 2-17).
   a. Determine 12 or 24 channel mode selection
(para 2-15) and frequency selection (para 3-10).             2-15. 12 or 24-Channel Mode Selection

   b. Preliminary starting procedure (para 3-11).            The radio set is shipped with the 12-channel mode
   c. Starting procedure (para 3-12.)                        modules installed. When 24-channel pem operation is
  d. Cable length adjustment (para 2-16).                    required, interchange the 12-and 24-channel mode
   e. Transmitter orderwire level adjustment (para           modules listed in the chart below. Refer to para-
5-35).                                                       graphs 5-80 and 5-31 for module replacement
  f. Transmitter traffic level adjustment (para 4-16).       instructions. For single stack radio sets, the 24-

                                NOTE                         double stack radio sets, the 24-channel mode
                                                             modules are stored in mode module drawer No. 6B
